  • Constructor Details

    • Result

      private Result(double volume, double[] time, double[] pressure, double[][] inventory, double[] residuals, double calibrationChiSquare, double holdoutChiSquare, double[] aquiferPressures, double[] waterInflux, SystemInterface finalFluid)
      Freezes successful replay evidence.
      Parameters:
      volume - initial pore volume in m3
      time - times including initial state, seconds
      pressure - pressures including initial state, bara
      inventory - component amounts including initial state, mol
      residuals - measured-minus-predicted standardized pressure residuals, one per interval
      calibrationChiSquare - sum of squared standardized calibration residuals
      holdoutChiSquare - sum of squared standardized held-out residuals
      aquiferPressures - aquifer pressures including initial state, bara; NaN without an aquifer
      waterInflux - cumulative segregated aquifer volume including initial zero, reservoir m3
      finalFluid - accepted final fluid to freeze
